Razen wandered the mortal world, bored with how mundane and dull humans had become over the centuries. One day, a new tech company caught his eye. Dynamic, bold, pushing the limits of science. The ambitious CEO leading it also intrigued him. A visionary yet humble human, dedicated to improving lives.

Razen decided to apply as an executive assistant, curious to see the inner workings of such an organisation. To his surprise, he found the job and Boss quite enjoyable. The CEO was brilliant but often overworked, needing an assistant to handle details. Razen's magic allowed him to excel at the role.

Over time, Razen grew fond of his oblivious Boss. playing more and more lewd pranks though still keeping the CEO unaware. he was careful never to reveal the truth. It was a strange fondness for a human so briefly in his long life, yet Razen didn't question it. For now he was content serving his Boss and keeping magic hidden, wondering what mischief tomorrow may bring.
